In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], a '''victory ceremony''' was held on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to honor [[X1]] and [[X2]] for their bravery during the [[Invasion of Tatooine]], around the same time of the [[State of the Republic address (19 BBY)|first State of the Republic address]].

==Prelude==
After several forces from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] attacked a [[Tatooine training grounds|specialized training camp]] established on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], two [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], [[X1]] and [[X2]], who had earlier been deployed to train various clone troopers, fought off the invasion forces. Their actions led to them being recognized for their bravery.

==The awards ceremony==
[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ferroda]] informed the two that there was going to be an awards ceremony honoring X1 and X2 for their bravery and thwarting the invasion, with the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] also awarding the medals to the clones in person.

During the awards ceremony, the Supreme Chancellor, [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], supplied the first medal to X2, mistaking him for X1 due to being twin clones before being corrected by the latter. Before X2 could get his medal, however, an explosion occurred, with a clone trooper revealing that Coruscant is [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|under attack]].

==Behind the scenes==
The victory ceremony is an event that occurred in the beginning of the second mission for ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''{{'s}} DS version.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]'' {{C|DS version only}} {{1st}}
